table_description: Time-of-day dimension with one row per second (86,400 rows total). Used to analyze sales patterns by time of day, shift, meal time, and AM/PM period. Sales fact tables join to this via their _SOLD_TIME_SK columns.
use_cases: Morning vs afternoon vs evening sales patterns
Meal time sales analysis (breakfast, lunch, dinner periods)
data_quality_notes: T_TIME_SK is the integer second of the day (0-86399). Join from fact tables on SS_SOLD_TIME_SK etc.
T_MEAL_TIME values: 'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', or NULL for non-meal periods.

table_columns.name: T_TIME_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key (seconds since midnight, 0-86399). Join from fact time SK columns.

table_columns.name: T_TIME_ID
table_columns.description: Business key for the time record.

table_columns.name: T_TIME
table_columns.description: Time as integer seconds since midnight.

table_columns.name: T_MEAL_TIME
table_columns.description: Meal period: 'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', or NULL outside meal times.
